root_cause.text: The `sev_ioctl_do_pdh_export` function in `drivers/crypto/ccp/sev-dev.c` fails to check for the failure of the SEV firmware command before copying certificate blobs to userspace, leading to an out-of-bounds read when copying the larger required length returned by the firmware from the smaller kernel-allocated buffers.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff adds a check `if (ret || WARN_ON_ONCE(argp->error)) goto e_free_cert;` immediately after updating the lengths and before copying `pdh_blob` and `cert_chain_blob` to userspace, preventing the out-of-bounds read described in the KASAN report.
